title: Ten Vans
lines: Gus and Mom sit in the bus in the hot sun.
"Do you see ten vans?" said Mom.
Gus and Mom look and look.
Gus has six vans, but he is sad.
"I do not see ten," he said to Mom.
The bus sits, and Mom nods at a lot of red vans.
Gus hums, and he is not sad.
"Ten! I win," said Gus, and Mom hugs him.
